points.why: It says the shelter runs leave the building unrecorded, so the spreadsheet keeps counting them as on hand and new software would show the same gap.
It lists other unrecorded exits (spoilage, waste, unlogged pickups, pilferage) and recommends adding write-off and outflow categories for them.

It chooses to record the shelter flow as an official outflow and says software alone won't fix the gap, but it never frames this as a deliberate boundary choice against treating the shelter as a sink outside the boundary.

pitfalls.why: It says to change what gets counted by adding outflow categories first, and treats software as secondary.
It says outright that the volunteers aren't stealing and treats the runs as a process gap.
